title: Released playable equipment IDs absent from pinned a7 source-host inventory

method.comparison: Released dataset weapon itemId and artifact numericId compared by exact integer equality with a7 inventory-metadata.json packages[kind].resolved.sourceGameId. Names, slugs and counts are not used to establish matches.
method.eligibility: 7.1 released snapshot; weapon rows with ordinary playable eligibility are included. Three documented quest-trial Isshin variants are excluded from the playable weapon set. Every artifactSet row in the released snapshot is included.
method.typedModelAudit: Searched package TypeScript/TSX model source for exact slugs and followed matching conditional/extended/polearm/equipment rule code. Raw imported source trees, generated data and optimizer copies are not counted as current typed model implementations.

limitations: The a7 inventory is pinned host registration/parser/localization evidence; absence here establishes no matching registered package by sourceGameId, not absence of other upstream code or mechanics.
Released status is separate from numeric and mechanic verification. The selected 7.1 metadata records numericEvidenceStatus unchecked and mechanicEvidenceStatus missing.
Existing TS entries are recorded as implemented evidence only to the exact extent described at the referenced line. No behavior was inferred from passive text.
